DESCRIPTION:
A classic LDAP injection payload in the username must not be able to
    widen the search filter to match an unintended entry.
NAME: test_username_is_escaped_in_search_filter

DESCRIPTION:
Both certificate and ServiceAccount users share one table — callers
    (CertificateService/ServiceAccountService) filter by type themselves.
NAME: test_type_isolation_between_cert_and_sa_users

DESCRIPTION:
A local account's own username must never be re-checked against LDAP,
    even if LDAP would happily authenticate someone by that name — local
    always wins for its own username.
NAME: test_local_account_never_falls_back_to_ldap

DESCRIPTION:
Guards against LDAP's classic unauthenticated-bind footgun: some
    directories treat an empty-password bind as a trivially successful
    'anonymous' bind rather than a credential check.
NAME: test_empty_password_rejected_without_attempting_a_bind

DESCRIPTION: A ClusterRole policy must not affect a Role of the same name.
NAME: test_policy_is_scoped_by_role_kind

DESCRIPTION:
A JIT grant must never collide with the `clustervision-{user}-{role}`
    name used by permanent assignments — the cleanup job deleting an expired
    JIT binding must not be able to touch a permanent one.
NAME: test_approved_binding_name_is_never_the_shared_permanent_name

DESCRIPTION:
Upgrade to head, downgrade all the way to base, upgrade back to
    head — this exact sequence is what would have caught the "upgrading an
    already-existing pre-Alembic schema needs a stamp first" failure mode
    during the ConfigMap -> Postgres migration.
NAME: test_upgrade_downgrade_upgrade_round_trip

DESCRIPTION:
SA names are only unique per namespace — the compound key must allow
    this, unlike a naive name-only primary key.
NAME: test_same_name_different_namespace_coexist

DESCRIPTION:
_update_configs must apply targeted changes (e.g. a token rotation)
    without disturbing other registered clusters.
NAME: test_update_configs_credential_rotation
